chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Sawwār, from al-Ḥasan, who said:

When ʿAlī عليه السلام defeated Ṭalḥah and al-Zubayr, the people came fleeing in defeat. They passed by a pregnant woman on the road, and she was terrified by them, so she cast what was in her womb alive; then it convulsed until it died, and then its mother died after it.

Then ʿAlī, may Allah’s blessings be upon him, passed by her with his companions while she was lying cast down and her child was on the road. He asked them about her case, and they said to him: She had been pregnant, then she was terrified when she saw the fighting and the defeat. He said: Then he asked them, “Which of the two died before the other?” They said: Her son died before her.

He said: Then he summoned her husband, the father of the deceased boy, and gave him as inheritance from the boy’s blood-money two-thirds of the blood-money, and gave his mother one-third of the blood-money as inheritance. Then he gave the husband from his deceased wife one-half of the one-third of the blood-money which she had inherited from her deceased son, and he gave the remainder to the relatives of the deceased woman.

He said: Then he also gave the husband from the blood-money of the deceased woman one-half of the blood-money, which was two thousand five hundred dirhams, and he gave the woman’s relatives one-half of the blood-money, which was two thousand five hundred dirhams. That was because she had no child other than the one she cast forth when she was terrified. He said: And he paid all of that from the treasury of al-Baṣrah.

key_terms.اَلزَّوْجَ: the husband, who received designated inheritance shares
key_terms.بَيْتِ مَالِ اَلْبَصْرَةِ: the public treasury of al-Baṣrah from which the compensation was paid
key_terms.دِيَتِهِ: the blood-money owed for the deceased child
key_terms.عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلَامُ: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, whose judicial ruling is being narrated
key_terms.قَرَابَةَ اَلْمَيِّتَةِ: the deceased woman’s relatives who inherited the remainder
key_terms.وَرَّثَهُ: he caused him to inherit; he assigned inheritance shares

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام rule on blood-money and inheritance when a frightened pregnant woman miscarried and then died?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts a judicial ruling of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning the death of a pregnant woman and her child caused by panic during a military defeat. It details how the diyah was apportioned through inheritance between the husband, the mother, and the woman’s relatives, and shows that the payment was made from the public treasury.
